# helpers4 (Rust)

> General-purpose Rust helpers: one crate, `helpers4`, one module per category, each behind its
> own Cargo feature (all enabled by default). Zero third-party dependencies by default, 100%
> test coverage, every rustdoc `# Examples` block is a doctest — treat those as verified usage.

## Conventions

- Import through the module path: `use helpers4::string::capitalize;`. Names may repeat across
  modules (`array::compact` vs `object::compact`), so never glob-import modules.
- Helpers take `&str`/slices and return owned values; nothing is mutated unless documented.
- `unsafe` is never used.

## Modules

- ansi — ANSI escape sequences: `strip`, `contains`, `visible_len`, `Style`, `Color`
- array — slice helpers not in `std`: `unique`, `unique_by`, `difference`, `intersection`,
  `symmetric_difference`, `intersects`, `equals_unordered`, `count_by`, `group_by`,
  `key_by`, `duplicates`, `interleave`, `cartesian_product`
- bytes — byte slices and sizes: `read_u16`, `read_u32`, `read_u64` (with `Endian`), `find`, `xor`,
  `constant_time_eq`, `format_size`, `parse_size`, `ParseSizeError`
- cache — in-memory stores with expiry and an injected clock: `ExpiringMap`, `ExpiringSet`
- ci — CI environments and pipeline status (the environment is a lookup function): `detect`, `is_ci`,
  `is_pull_request`, `Provider`, `Status`, `overall`, `render_report`
- color — colors: `Rgb` (parse `#rgb`, `#rrggbb`, `rgb()`, names), `Hsl`, `mix`, `contrast_ratio` (WCAG),
  `best_text_color`, `ParseColorError`
- commit — Conventional Commits: `Commit` (parse), `Bump`, `bump_for`, `is_valid`, `emoji_for`,
  `ParseCommitError`
- date — calendar dates without time zones: `Date`, `Weekday`, `DateError`, `is_leap_year`,
  `days_in_month`
- duration — human-readable durations (`1h30m`): `parse`, `format`, `ParseDurationError`
- env — dotenv content helpers (pure text, no I/O): `parse`, `get`, `set`, `remove`, `get_bool`,
  `get_int`, `get_list`, `get_duration`
- fs — file-system helpers: `write_atomic`, `read_to_string_opt`, `walk`, `normalize` and `is_within`
  (lexical path checks, no I/O)
- function — functions: `compose`, `pipe`, `Memoize`, `retry`, `backoff`, `TokenBucket` (rate limiter with an
  injected clock)
- future — runtime-neutral futures, std only: `block_on`, `now_or_never`, `yield_now`, `join`, `join_all`
- hex — byte/text encodings with typed errors: `encode`, `encode_upper`, `decode`,
  `decode_to_slice`, `decode_array`, `base64_encode`, `base64_decode`, `Base64DecodeError`,
  `base32_encode`, `base32_decode`, `Base32DecodeError`
- http — HTTP header value helpers: `bearer_token` (RFC 7235 / 6750)
- iter — helpers for any `Iterator`: `chunk`, `min_max`, `first_duplicate`
- license — SPDX licenses: `lookup`, `normalize`, `Expression` (parse and evaluate `MIT OR Apache-2.0`),
  `Category`, `LicenseInfo`, `header`, `ParseExpressionError`
- map — `HashMap` helpers: `pick`, `omit`, `map_values`
- markdown — writing Markdown safely: `escape`, `link`, `inline_code`, `code_block`, `blockquote`, `table`,
  `heading_slug`
- net — network address and hostname checks: `is_public_ip` (SSRF guard, IANA registry),
  `is_valid_hostname`, `HostnameError`
- number — numeric helpers: `lerp`, `round_to`, `mean`, `median`, `percentage`, `gcd`, `lcm`
- secret — keeping secrets out of logs: `Secret`, `redact`, `mask`, `detect`, `scan`, `TokenKind`, `Finding`
- set — `HashSet` helpers: `union_all`, `intersection_all`, `toggle`, `to_sorted_vec`, `jaccard`, `subsets`
- string — string manipulation: `capitalize`, `title_case`, `camel_case`, `pascal_case`,
  `snake_case`, `kebab_case`, `constant_case`, `slugify`, `truncate`, `excerpt`, `squish`,
  `indent`, `dedent`, `escape_html`, `unescape_html`, `escape_regex`, `words`,
  `levenshtein_distance`, `levenshtein_similarity`, and (feature `string-diacritics`, the one
  optional dependency in this crate: `unicode-normalization`) `remove_diacritics`
- time — the system clock as unix time: `unix_now`, `unix_now_millis`, `ClockError`
- url — URLs: `Url` (RFC 3986 parse and reference resolution), `percent_encode`, `percent_decode`,
  `parse_query`, `build_query`, `join_path`, `UrlError`
- validate — shape checks: `is_valid_email`, `is_uuid`, `is_slug`
- version — semantic versioning: `Version`, `VersionReq` (Cargo-style requirements), `compare`, `satisfies`,
  `ParseVersionError`
